essence: The supreme being encompasses cosmic perception, universal consumption, and complete transcendence.
Supreme lordship is compatible with complete detachment and marvelous enjoyment.
The supreme being is all-encompassing, consort of the goddess, and fully adorned.
Supreme knowledge and leadership place the being above all deities.
The being both protects and crowns the entire divine assembly.
